title: euodia lepta var. cambodiana
intro: Euodia lepta var. cambodiana, commonly known as Cambodian Euodia, is a plant species within the Rutaceae family and is native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Euodia lepta var. cambodiana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including limonoids, which have been shown to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific bioactive constituents and their therapeutic actions, but the plant is known to contain compounds like limonoids and flavonoids.
